claims.text: Hugging Face published Transformers v5.15.0 on 2026-08-10 UTC and included Meta Muse Glimmer under New Model additions.
The Hugging Face release notes describe Muse Glimmer as a dense 30B multimodal model with a 2B vision encoder and 28B text decoder and state that it was released that day under Apache 2.0.

limitations.text: This verifies the Hugging Face integration/release-note record, not the exact Meta first-party announcement or W33 X momentum; those remain part of the Grok r3 reconciliation.

targets.finding: The Hugging Face project release and its Muse Glimmer model-addition text are directly verified. Exact Meta-origin chronology and X-trend strength remain separate open questions for r3.
